scope: Actual isolated jarvis-node, jarvis-hook and tmux; synthetic provider homes and receiver; no provider authorization or VM provisioning

checks.scenario: running protocol advertises per-source capabilities
two Codex homes have distinct stable identities
same raw session ID remains distinct across homes
project history preserves source identities
provider auth file is outside transcript read boundary
configured nondefault transcript is readable
actual installed hook reaches node with canonical instance identity
source-targeted launch receives a real pane
launch selects requested account instead of inherited account
live remote terminal screen is available
written answer has acknowledgement and arrives literally
remote key plan is acknowledged only after literal delivery
managed remote shim replaces stale socket and account on existing server
interactive shim session actually delivers its hook to the node
unknown account cannot silently launch the default
unsupported Codex official quota is explicit, never another account
trust repair cannot select an unregistered home or command
real Codex RPC trusts the selected remote source only
remote trust preserves approvals and sandbox configuration
remote trust repair is idempotent
